## Definition (SPEC, engine code triggers_c/featc.py + core.py + defs.py)

- x = b_ofi per bar = cOFI(last 1 ms L1-grid record at or before the bar known time) - cOFI(last record at or before the WINDOW START); window start = the previous bar known time in the same session, or t0 - 1 ns (t0 = first print of the bar) for the first bar of a session. cOFI = running sum over the day grid of the Cont-Kukanov-Stoikov increment e_i = [bp_i >= bp_i-1] bq_i - [bp_i <= bp_i-1] bq_i-1 - [ap_i <= ap_i-1] aq_i + [ap_i >= ap_i-1] aq_i-1 on the 1 ms grid of best bid/ask price (ticks) and size (the book grid is the history-store field g1; one record per ms with a change).
- xs = pandas ewm(span 3, adjust=False, ignore_na=True).mean() of x over the continuous bar series of the row (all sessions in order sess_id, known time; alpha 0.5; seeded with the first value); sd = rolling std (ddof 1) of xs over the last 200 bars of the SAME continuous series, defined when at least max(5, 200 // 3) = 66 valid values exist; y = xs / sd; LONG when y >= 2.0, SHORT when y <= -2.0, as a level; the signal is the EDGE (first bar of the condition); bars with part = 1 never signal.
- Verified on this day: re-deriving b_ofi from the 1 ms grid (code/d8_spec2/ofi_check.py) equals the stored feature on 205 of 205 NY AM bars (max abs difference 0.0); recomputing xs, sd, y and the edge from the stored x reproduces all 6,815 engine events (code/d8_spec2/feat_tables.py).
